# Zenvo Academy
> Zenvo Academy (https://zenvoacademy.in/) is an AI-focused academy in India that teaches AI video creation in Tamil through a beginner-friendly, pre-recorded online course.

## Course
- AI Video Creation Master Course: 17 practical lessons in Tamil covering prompt engineering, AI images, AI avatars, business posters, Canva AI, image-to-video, cinematic and story videos, voiceovers, AI songs, mobile editing and AI movies.
- Format: online, pre-recorded. Level: beginner. Language: Tamil.
- Price: Rs 499 current offer price (regular price Rs 5,999).
